question: In what manner does the supreme sādhaka embody the power to grant enjoyment and liberation?
premises: The supreme sādhaka causes both worldly enjoyment and liberation.
This capacity is directly manifest in the supreme sādhaka.
The supreme sādhaka possesses the very nature of a wish-fulfilling tree.
inference: Therefore the supreme sādhaka is a directly manifest, wish-fulfilling source of both enjoyment and liberation.
uncertainties: The case and gender of the adjectives follow the context of sādhakottamam from the preceding verse.
plain_english: He is directly manifest as one who grants both enjoyment and liberation, having the very nature of a wish-fulfilling tree.
